\[
\hat{x} = \text{PixelShuffle}_4\big(f_\theta(y)\big) + \text{nearest}_4(y)
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(y\): The small image
- \(f_\theta\): The network

The compact network runs 34 convolutions with PReLU at the small size, and a pixel shuffle turns its 48 channels into a picture four times larger. The nearest-neighbor enlargement of the input is added, so the network learns only the missing detail. Training with a GAN loss makes the detail look real, not exact.
